description: Synthetic HTML fixture with a known number of violations for every rule in sections 1-3 of brand_style_ai_writing_pass.md. Line numbers refer to the raw file. Derived by hand with grep -n on 2026-09-23, independently of style_lint.py.

em_dash.note: two — on L14 (one sentence), a literal on L15, — on L16, — on L17. The em dashes in the comment (L4) and the CSS (L7, L9) must not count.

curly_quote.note: two literal curly doubles, ’, “, ” on L18. Straight quotes on the same line must not count; the curly quotes in the comment (L4) and CSS (L7) must not count.

bold.note: one <strong> wraps from L19 onto L20 and counts once, at L19. The <strong> in the comment (L4) and the CSS font-weight (L8) must not count.

heading_title_case.note: h1 L11 and h3 L22 are Title Case. 'Working with Liberation Labs' (L21) is a proper noun and must not be flagged. <title> is not a heading.

emoji_marker.note: emoji as a heading marker (L23) and as bullets (L25, L26). The emoji inside a sentence on L27 must not count.

negative_parallelism.note: L40 holds three controls that must not count: 'would rather say less than promise more' (comparative preference, not the tell), 'is not a compliance checkbox' (plain negation), 'Nottingham'.

copula_avoidance.note: L44 'The features are listed' and 'their offers were declined' are nouns and must not count. 'boasts' on L46 is also banned vocabulary and counts under both rules.

banned_vocabulary.note: 'Leveraging' on L46 is the inflected form and counts under 'leverage'.
